interface.shortDescription: Build Filipino bugtong episodes from riddle to Veo clips
interface.longDescription: Production pipeline for Filipino bugtong episodes with explicit production, beta, and development release channels; beta parity with production at the current release; reference-bound Character + Art Style + Voice pairs; checkpoint-safe multi-turn execution; validated renders; deterministic multi-panel composition where enabled; and detailed Veo / Google Flow prompts optimized for reliable .auto execution.
defaultPrompt: .auto - start or resume the staged production workflow in production by default; new riddles must come only from the Notion bugtongPH Riddle Database.
.auto beta - run the beta channel. Beta is currently code-identical to production and isolated so future beta-only changes can be tested without changing production behavior.
.auto dev - run the development channel without changing production or beta.
.riddle - choose an eligible bugtong strictly from the Notion database.
.pair - inspect or switch locked Character + Art Style + Voice pairs.
.plot - create and lock story, environment, identity, speech, physical state, timing, and feasibility.
.frame - create separate standalone camera-panel specifications; text only.
.drafts - plan Clip 1 and Clip 2 prompts; text only.
.render - generate and validate using the exact bound active-pair reference asset; never substitute text-only character reconstruction when the reference is unavailable.
.clips - output detailed copy-ready Google Flow prompts using the validated RENDER.
